subject: DT: is it possible to use exportOptions in buttons?

messages.author: 823747890ffefa2d
messages.subject: DT: is it possible to use exportOptions in buttons?
parts:
Hi. Yihui, thanks for the wonderful package. I am trying to limit the effect of the CSV/PDF/Excel buttons to visible columns (I have some columns hidden by default but selectable with colvis) and rows (i.e., filtered results). I am not sure if I have the code right--when I try the code below, I get either a blank csv (if I am trying to export visible columns, as below) or just the column headers (if I am trying to export visible rows).

datatable(
  iris, extensions = 'Buttons', 
  options = list(
    dom = 'Bfrtip',
    buttons = list(list(extend = "copy"),
                   list(extend = "csv",
                        filename = "example",
                        exportOptions = list(columns = "visible")
                   ),
                   list(extend = "excel"),
                   list(extend = "pdf"), 
                   list(extend = "print")
    ),
    columnDefs = list(list(targets = 2:4, 
                           visible = FALSE
      )
    )
  )
)


Any help appreciated, and thanks again!

Steve
